Package com.j3d.engine.react.events.payloads

Class CommandFiredPayload

java.lang.Object
com.j3d.engine.react.events.EventPayload<Command>
com.j3d.engine.react.events.payloads.CommandFiredPayload
public class CommandFiredPayload extends EventPayload<Command>
Event payload for when any command has been fired.

This event stores:

  • The Command instance of the command being fired (the emitter of the event)
  • The Invoker which describes the invocation of the command
  • The aliasUsed to invoke the command
  • The argsCopy[] to view the arguments that got passed into the command
  • The taggedArgsCopy to view the tagged arguments that got passed into the command
